dialogues.jp:
日曜の午後は、街中の散歩がよく似合う。一人
でぶらぶらするこの心地よさ。
dialogues.en:
Sunday afternoon, I'm walking down a nameless street. All by
myself, just idly loitering around.
dialogues.text:
Sunday afternoon, I'm walking down a nameless street. All by
myself, just idly loitering around.

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、誰か居てくれたらなあ、などと思っ
たり。
dialogues.en:
Then again, I certainly wouldn't mind if someone else was
walking with me.
dialogues.text:
Then again, I certainly wouldn't mind if someone else was
walking with me.

dialogues.jp: かわいい彼女と二人きり、とか。
dialogues.en: Such as a couple of cute girls.
dialogues.text: Such as a couple of cute girls.

dialogues.en: "Br.... cold..."
dialogues.text: "Br.... cold..."

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ春の足音が聞こえてきたとは言え、２
月の空気はまだまだ身を引き締めてくれる。商
店街を行く人も、冬の装いが目立つ。
dialogues.en:
Although spring is coming, the Feburary weather is still
stiffening to the body. People still walk around in winter
clothing. ;[name]
dialogues.text:
Although spring is coming, the Feburary weather is still
stiffening to the body. People still walk around in winter
clothing. ;[name]

dialogues.jp: 「やば……マジ寒い……」
dialogues.en: "It's... really friggin cold..."
dialogues.text: "It's... really friggin cold..."

dialogues.jp: 思ったより、軽装過ぎたらしい。
dialogues.en: Looks like it's not the time for light wear yet...
dialogues.text: Looks like it's not the time for light wear yet...

dialogues.jp: 「誰か、セーターでも編んでくれねえかな……」
dialogues.en: "Someone, please knit a sweater for me right now..."
dialogues.text: "Someone, please knit a sweater for me right now..."

dialogues.jp:
やくたいもない事を考えつつ、本屋やＣＤショッ
プを中心に、商店街をぶらぶらした。
dialogues.en:
Thinking crazy thoughts, I enter a book and CD shop for the
warmth, and continue loafing around.
dialogues.text:
Thinking crazy thoughts, I enter a book and CD shop for the
warmth, and continue loafing around.

dialogues.jp: 初音島は本日も平穏だった。
dialogues.en: Hatsunejima is pretty quiet today.
dialogues.text: Hatsunejima is pretty quiet today.

dialogues.jp: 「てか、暇だ……」
dialogues.en: "Time to leave..."
dialogues.text: "Time to leave..."

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ帰ろうかとも思うが、せっかく外に出
たのだから、他の場所にも寄りたい気もする。
dialogues.en:
As I gradually leave the shop, I started thinking of other
places to go.
dialogues.text:
As I gradually leave the shop, I started thinking of other
places to go.

dialogues.jp:
人混みはかったるいし、映画をひとりで見るの
もあれだ。ましてや喫茶店とかに入ってもな。
dialogues.en:
I don't feel like being in a crowd today, so going to a
movie is out of the question. To say nothing of going to a
coffeeshop.
dialogues.text:
I don't feel like being in a crowd today, so going to a
movie is out of the question. To say nothing of going to a
coffeeshop.

dialogues.jp: 「無難に公園でも行ってみるか……」
dialogues.en: "I guess the safest option would be the park..."
dialogues.text: "I guess the safest option would be the park..."

dialogues.jp:
テレビじゃ、４月になると『桜の花も満開にな
りすっかり春気分です』なんて言うけれど、こ
の島じゃ、そんな言葉は的はずれだ。
dialogues.en:
I saw from the TV once that sakura trees are in full bloom
in April, but that's a law of nature that doesn't apply
here.
dialogues.text:
I saw from the TV once that sakura trees are in full bloom
in April, but that's a law of nature that doesn't apply
here.

dialogues.jp:
掃除をしても掃除をしても、まるで足りないほ
どに、絶え間なく花びらの散る公園。
dialogues.en:
This park continually gets cleaned up, yet the sakura petals
continue to fall to the point where it's hard to walk
through.
dialogues.text:
This park continually gets cleaned up, yet the sakura petals
continue to fall to the point where it's hard to walk
through.

dialogues.jp: 「……それにしても誰もいないな」
dialogues.en: "...And that may be why no one else is around."
dialogues.text: "...And that may be why no one else is around."

dialogues.jp:
予想はしていたが、公園には散歩をしている老
人がぽつぽつといる程度で、数える程もいない。
dialogues.en:
As I predicted, the only ones walking around the park are a
few elderly people.
dialogues.text:
As I predicted, the only ones walking around the park are a
few elderly people.

dialogues.jp:
普通に公園内をぶらついてもつまらない。俺は、
道筋から外れ、桜の林の中へ入っていく。
dialogues.en:
I'd be bored if I take the normal route through as well.
Instead, I go off the path and into the forest of sakura
trees.
dialogues.text:
I'd be bored if I take the normal route through as well.
Instead, I go off the path and into the forest of sakura
trees.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花の匂いがより強く｛びこう／鼻腔｝をくすぐる。思わ
ず触れた桜の木の幹からは、しっとりと冷たい
感触が伝わってくる。
dialogues.en:
The smell of the sakura petals grew stronger. If I touch one
of the sakura tree's trunks now, it'd feel cold to the
touch.
dialogues.text:
The smell of the sakura petals grew stronger. If I touch one
of the sakura tree's trunks now, it'd feel cold to the
touch.

dialogues.jp:
見上げると、空が見えないくらい覆い尽くされ
た薄い桃色の景色。
dialogues.en:
As I look up, the sky was hidden, covered by a thin shade of
pink.
dialogues.text:
As I look up, the sky was hidden, covered by a thin shade of
pink.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうだ、あそこに行ってみるか」
dialogues.en: "...Hm, I should go there."
dialogues.text: "...Hm, I should go there."

dialogues.jp:
この近くに、子供の頃、秘密基地と呼んでいた
場所があった。
dialogues.en: Close to here is the secret base I used to have as a child.
dialogues.text: Close to here is the secret base I used to have as a child.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、今の目で見れば、大層なもんじゃな
い。
dialogues.en: Of course, if I look at it now, it wasn't much of one.
dialogues.text: Of course, if I look at it now, it wasn't much of one.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、ガキにとっては、両手を広げても追い
つかないくらい、大切な場所。
dialogues.en:
But when I was a kid, and when it was bigger than my hands
outstretched, it was a very important place for me.
dialogues.text:
But when I was a kid, and when it was bigger than my hands
outstretched, it was a very important place for me.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……行ってみよう」
dialogues.en: "Right.. I'd go."
dialogues.text: "Right.. I'd go."

dialogues.jp: 呟いた時には、足が勝手に動いていた。
dialogues.en:
As I murmured that, my feet started heading in the direction
of that place.
dialogues.text:
As I murmured that, my feet started heading in the direction
of that place.

dialogues.jp: 満開の桜。
dialogues.en: The sakura are in full bloom.
dialogues.text: The sakura are in full bloom.

dialogues.jp:
何歳になるのか考えると、気が遠くなってしま
うような、太い幹。
dialogues.en:
Ever since young, I always thought of this huge sakura tree
as my second home.
dialogues.text:
Ever since young, I always thought of this huge sakura tree
as my second home.

dialogues.jp:
見る者を圧倒するようで、何だか、優しくもあ
る。
dialogues.en:
To others, it looks overwhelming, yet it has such a gentle
air to it.
dialogues.text:
To others, it looks overwhelming, yet it has such a gentle
air to it.

dialogues.jp: 「……ってか、今見ても、すごいなこれは」
dialogues.en: "...Even if I look at it now, it's still amazing."
dialogues.text: "...Even if I look at it now, it's still amazing."

dialogues.jp: いつだったか夢でも見たような気がするが……。
dialogues.en: It's like experiencing a dream.
dialogues.text: It's like experiencing a dream.

dialogues.jp: 花の香り。
dialogues.en: The fragrance of the flowers.
dialogues.text: The fragrance of the flowers.

dialogues.jp: 吹き抜ける風。
dialogues.en: The lightly blowing wind.
dialogues.text: The lightly blowing wind.

dialogues.jp: 唇に張り付いた花びら。
dialogues.en: The sakura petals that cling to ones lips.
dialogues.text: The sakura petals that cling to ones lips.

dialogues.jp:
そんな｛もろもろ／諸々｝が、夢とは比較にならない程の濃密
さで迫ってくる。
dialogues.en: All these various things mirror the dreams I've often had.
dialogues.text: All these various things mirror the dreams I've often had.

dialogues.jp: 不意に、すぐ近くから、歌声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, nearby, I could hear someone singing.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, nearby, I could hear someone singing.

dialogues.jp: 「……歌？　こんな所で？」
dialogues.en: "...Singing? In this place?"
dialogues.text: "...Singing? In this place?"

dialogues.jp:
妖精でも歌っているのかなんて、妙な事を考え
てしまう。
dialogues.en: Sounding like a fairy's song, I thought weirdly.
dialogues.text: Sounding like a fairy's song, I thought weirdly.

dialogues.jp: 場所も意外だが、その歌声の綺麗な事。
dialogues.en:
While the location might be odd, the singing itself is
beautiful.
dialogues.text:
While the location might be odd, the singing itself is
beautiful.

dialogues.jp:
外国の歌らしく、言葉は聞き取れないが、メロ
ディの美しさはすぐに分かる。
dialogues.en:
It's a foreign song. While the words are incomprehensible to
me, I can at least tell that the melody is beautiful.
dialogues.text:
It's a foreign song. While the words are incomprehensible to
me, I can at least tell that the melody is beautiful.

dialogues.jp: 「誰なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Who is it?"
dialogues.text: "Who is it?"

dialogues.jp: すぐ近く──桜の大木の背後へと回り込む。
dialogues.en:
I slowly move closer to the sound of the song-- from the
rear of the huge sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
I slowly move closer to the sound of the song-- from the
rear of the huge sakura tree.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花びらが舞い散る中で、少女が髪をなびか
せながら、歌声を奏でていた。
dialogues.en:
Within the dancing sakura petals, a young girl, her hair
fluttering, was singing her song.
dialogues.text:
Within the dancing sakura petals, a young girl, her hair
fluttering, was singing her song.

dialogues.jp: 身体が動かない。
dialogues.en: Her body was completely still.
dialogues.text: Her body was completely still.

dialogues.jp:
見とれるというのは、こういうことなんだなと
思いながら、ただただ歌声を感じていた。
dialogues.en:
I can't think of anything to say or do, just stare and feel
the song.
dialogues.text:
I can't think of anything to say or do, just stare and feel
the song.

dialogues.jp:
猿の惑星で人間を発見してしまったように、二
人、見つめ合う。
dialogues.en:
Like humans from the planet of the apes meeting, we stared
at each other.
dialogues.text:
Like humans from the planet of the apes meeting, we stared
at each other.

dialogues.jp:
歌声は途絶えてしまい、今はただ、耳の中に余
韻として残っているのみ。
dialogues.en:
The singing ceased immediately. My ear still felt the
reveberations of her song.
dialogues.text:
The singing ceased immediately. My ear still felt the
reveberations of her song.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: 'Y, yes?"
dialogues.text: 'Y, yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いつから、そこに居ました？」
dialogues.en: "How long have you been here?"
dialogues.text: "How long have you been here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……私、歌っていると、周りの事が頭に入ら
　なくなっちゃうんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"...When I sing, I completely forget about everything around
me."
dialogues.text:
"...When I sing, I completely forget about everything around
me."

dialogues.jp: てへへと笑って、頭をこつんと小突いた。
dialogues.en: She giggled slightly, and poked her head.
dialogues.text: She giggled slightly, and poked her head.

dialogues.jp:
そんな風にすると、さっきの堂々たる歌いっぷ
りが、何だか嘘みたいに思えてくる。
dialogues.en:
With these conditions, and given the amazing song I just
heard, I thought of making a joke.
dialogues.text:
With these conditions, and given the amazing song I just
heard, I thought of making a joke.

dialogues.jp: 「３日くらい前かな」
dialogues.en: "About 3 days."
dialogues.text: "About 3 days."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……何だ、冗談ですか」
dialogues.en: "....Oh, it's a joke."
dialogues.text: "....Oh, it's a joke."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それで、いつからです？」
dialogues.en: "Really now, how long have you been here?"
dialogues.text: "Really now, how long have you been here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いつからっていうか、まあ、２、３分だと思
　うけど」
dialogues.en: "When, well, around 2-3 minutes ago or so."
dialogues.text: "When, well, around 2-3 minutes ago or so."

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、時間の感覚なんてなかったので、
よく分からない。
dialogues.en:
Although I said that, I had completely lost all sense of
time while listening to her song.
dialogues.text:
Although I said that, I had completely lost all sense of
time while listening to her song.

dialogues.jp: まあ、１時間ではないと思うが……。
dialogues.en: Well, it's probably no longer than an hour...
dialogues.text: Well, it's probably no longer than an hour...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今の歌、１０分の曲なんですよ」
dialogues.en: "That song was a 10-minute tune."
dialogues.text: "That song was a 10-minute tune."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、１０分より長いって事はないと思う
　んです」
dialogues.en:
"So, you couldn't have been here longer than 10 minutes, I
think."
dialogues.text:
"So, you couldn't have been here longer than 10 minutes, I
think."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、なるほどな。そういやさっきも、キリ
　のいいところで、俺の事に気が付いたみたい
　だし」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, I see. You left off at a great time to notice me as
well, then."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, I see. You left off at a great time to notice me as
well, then."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yep!"
dialogues.text: "Yep!"

dialogues.jp:
にっこりと笑う。思わず、頭をぐしゃぐしゃと
やりたくなるくらい、人なつこい笑顔。
dialogues.en:
She laughed with a sweet smile, a smile filled with
tenderness. Just then, a sakura petal floated into her face.
dialogues.text:
She laughed with a sweet smile, a smile filled with
tenderness. Just then, a sakura petal floated into her face.

dialogues.jp: ぐしゃぐしゃ。
dialogues.en: *gushagusha*
dialogues.text: *gushagusha*

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……って、わわわ。な、何ですか？　急に」
dialogues.en: "whawhawha, what was that? It happened so fast..."
dialogues.text: "whawhawha, what was that? It happened so fast..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こんなところで歌ってるから、桜の花びらが
　ついてるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"The sakura petals must be delighted that you were singing
here, and were showing their appreciation."
dialogues.text:
"The sakura petals must be delighted that you were singing
here, and were showing their appreciation."

dialogues.jp: 言いつつ、位置のずれた帽子を元に戻した。
dialogues.en:
While saying that, I grabbed her hat, which slipped off her
head, and returned it to it's original position.
dialogues.text:
While saying that, I grabbed her hat, which slipped off her
head, and returned it to it's original position.

dialogues.jp: 「良し、もう大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "There we go, good as ever."
dialogues.text: "There we go, good as ever."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとうございます。こういうのって、自
　分じゃ気づけないですからね」
dialogues.en: "Thank you. I only just noticed that."
dialogues.text: "Thank you. I only just noticed that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "No problem."
dialogues.text: "No problem."

dialogues.jp:
というか、元から花びらなんてついてないから、
絶対気づけないと思うけどな。
dialogues.en:
It's not exactly easy to predict the falling patterns of a
falling sakura petal anyway...
dialogues.text:
It's not exactly easy to predict the falling patterns of a
falling sakura petal anyway...

dialogues.jp: 単にぐしゃぐしゃっとやりたくなっただけだし。
dialogues.en: It'd be simpler to think that it just wanted to fall there.
dialogues.text: It'd be simpler to think that it just wanted to fall there.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　それってセクハラですか？！」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?! Isn't that sexual harassment?!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?! Isn't that sexual harassment?!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ。こっちの話です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, never mind. What were we saying?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, never mind. What were we saying?"

dialogues.jp: う〜ん、何なんだろうか、この会話の間は。
dialogues.en: Oy, what's with these weird conversation bits?
dialogues.text: Oy, what's with these weird conversation bits?

dialogues.jp:
野球のつもりが、テニスボールをミットに収め
てしまったような、そんな感じ。
dialogues.en:
It's like trying to catch a tennis ball with a baseball
glove; that's how I felt trying to catch what she was saying
at times.
dialogues.text:
It's like trying to catch a tennis ball with a baseball
glove; that's how I felt trying to catch what she was saying
at times.

dialogues.jp: 「ていうか、俺の事、覚えてる？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, any chance that you remember me?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, any chance that you remember me?"

dialogues.jp: さすがに、初対面の人間に、あんな事はしない。
dialogues.en: But for a first meeting for her, it couldn't really happen.
dialogues.text: But for a first meeting for her, it couldn't really happen.

dialogues.jp:
その驚きに、微妙に悲しくなる。人から忘れら
れるってのは切ないものだ。
dialogues.en:
The surprise on her face made me feel slightly disappointed.
Am I such an easily forgettable person?
dialogues.text:
The surprise on her face made me feel slightly disappointed.
Am I such an easily forgettable person?

dialogues.jp:
俺は目の前の人物と初めてまともに会話した時
のことを思い出した。
dialogues.en:
I start to remember the first conversation I had with the
person in front of me.
dialogues.text:
I start to remember the first conversation I had with the
person in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
……って、あれがまともかどうかは微妙なとこ
だけど。
dialogues.en: ...And I suppose there was nothing "slightly" about it.
dialogues.text: ...And I suppose there was nothing "slightly" about it.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりとの再会◆
dialogues.en: ◆Reunion with Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆Reunion with Kotori◆

dialogues.jp: 何となく行った桜公園。
dialogues.en: I ended up in the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: I ended up in the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
そこで、ことりに出会った。ことりは歌を歌っ
ていた。
dialogues.en: I met up with Kotori there. She was singing a song.
dialogues.text: I met up with Kotori there. She was singing a song.

dialogues.jp:
だけど、俺のことを思い出せないことりに、俺
はショックを受ける。
dialogues.en: However, I got a shock when she couldn't remember me.
dialogues.text: However, I got a shock when she couldn't remember me.

dialogues.jp: ……なんで忘れてるかなぁ。
dialogues.en: ...How could you have forgotten!
dialogues.text: ...How could you have forgotten!
